definition: A formation is an explicit operational body representing a conserved subset of one source force. Its size is chosen for useful simulation resolution rather than a mandatory echelon.
component_rule: A formation may contain aggregate components with different roles or troop pools. Components are internal accounting and capability groups, not separate manpower owners.
named_team_rule: An exact named team may be attached to or embedded in a formation. Its members are already included in formation headcount. A four-person team inside a 500-person formation means four exact people plus 496 aggregate personnel, never 504.
large_war_rule: Represent a 10,000-person field commitment with a bounded number of operational formations appropriate to the theater. Ordinary squad structure remains implicit in doctrine and composition; materialize exact teams only when identity can change local causality.

split_transaction.trigger: Use split when a durable subset becomes independently assigned or needs persistent state that differs materially from the remainder.
conservation: equipment and ammunition claims when tracked
injury and fatigue state when tracked
split_transaction.default_partition: Anonymous aggregate state is partitioned proportionally and deterministically. Do not silently put the best personnel into one child.
split_transaction.selected_partition: Selecting particular people requires an explicit lawful selection action; resulting child state is recalculated from that selection.
split_transaction.identity: The remainder may keep the parent formation ID while the detached child receives a new stable formation ID. Personnel claims may never overlap.

preconditions: compatible operational composition or explicit reconciliation
doctrine, training and command differences resolved
merge_transaction.result: Headcount and material claims are conserved. Readiness and morale combine by weighted state; integration may temporarily reduce cohesion.
merge_transaction.forbidden: Merge never heals casualties, resets fatigue, recreates equipment, erases history or creates free capability.

vectorized_resolution.rule: Equivalent formations or components may be evaluated together when all materially relevant inputs are equivalent.
vectorized_resolution.settlement: Allocate casualties, fatigue, ammunition, equipment loss and other consequences deterministically back to the real formation IDs.
vectorized_resolution.no_hidden_layer: Do not persist a resolution batch as another organization layer.

core_invariants: The source force is the single aggregate manpower owner.
Explicit formation personnel never exceed source-force deployed personnel.
Named people and exact teams embedded in a formation are subsets of its headcount.
Split and merge conserve all represented people and material claims.
Command authority does not duplicate manpower ownership.
Large ordinary formations stay aggregate until exact identity becomes causally relevant.
